summary: Comprehensive testing of Server site type and XML imports feature. Backend: 20/20 tests PASSED. Frontend: All UI components verified - Server site creation modal shows 3 site types (Standard/Technical/Server), XML Dashboard with table/filters/pagination, XML Upload with drag-drop, Import Details with metadata and XML preview, API Keys management.
seed_data_creation: Test created several TEST_ prefixed API keys which were cleaned up. Some XML test uploads remain in the Server site.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Server site type feature is fully functional. Key verified flows: 1) Network Dashboard shows 'Clara Server' as third site type option with 'XML imports & sync' description. 2) Server sites auto-redirect to /xml-imports on entry. 3) XML upload via /api/xml-imports/upload requires X-Main-Site-ID header, validates .xml extension, returns import_id + status=processing. 4) Background processing extracts metadata (project_name, version, date, element_count) from XML content. 5) Agent upload via /api/xml-imports/agent/upload uses API key auth (Authorization: Bearer <key>) without user JWT. 6) API keys are hashed, only shown once on creation, list endpoint excludes key_hash. 7) XML files stored locally at /app/storage/xml_imports/ (S3 fallback). 8) Sidebar shows 'Server' nav group with 'XML Imports' and 'API Keys' items.
